integrity: The proof independently derives the seven gcd classes, their exact cardinalities, and the divisor-incomparability quotient. The quotient automorphism group is calculated explicitly and every nonidentity symmetry is ruled out by a symbolic class-size obstruction for distinct primes. The standalone verifier exhausts all quotient permutations and directly reconstructs three modular cozero-divisor graphs from gcd divisibility.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to distinct primes and the balanced exponent pattern p^2 q^2.
General p^a q^b cozero-divisor graphs may have larger quotient automorphism groups and are not covered.
Only graph automorphisms are classified; the image of ring automorphisms is not.
title: Symmetry breaking in the cozero-divisor graph of \(\mathbb Z/(p^2q^2)\mathbb Z\)
